name: Sudice (Třebíč District, Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a green band into a white upper fly part with a green hat-shaped charge and a red lower hoist part with a yellow adze blade.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 June 2001 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
